lines: Five seconds. That’s fine. Five is a healthy number. Plenty of time to think. Don’t overthink. Actually do think. Just… efficiently.
Four. Still good. Four’s respectable. I’ve seen worse numbers.
Three. Right. Now it’s starting to look a bit… small.
Two. Oh that’s intimate. That’s uncomfortably intimate.
One. Well. I sincerely hope that was deliberate.
Five seconds. Take your time. Not too much time. That would be unfortunate.
Four. Still waiting. Still very much waiting.
Three. This is the bit where people panic. Are you panicking? You should be panicking.
Two. That’s not enough time for a personality change.
One. And now we find out what you’ve done.
Five seconds. You’ve gone very quiet. I don’t like quiet.
Four. Silence is rarely a sign of brilliance.
Three. You should absolutely be speaking by now.
Two. I can’t answer for you. That’s not how this works.
One. This is entirely your decision.
Five seconds remaining. Survival probability stable. Barely.
Four seconds. Margin narrowing. Charts adjusting.
Three. That’s statistically where errors bloom.
Two. This is the danger spike.
One. Outcome locked. No revisions.
Five seconds! You’re fine. You look fine. I mean you don’t look fine, but metaphorically fine.
Four. Still manageable. Slightly less manageable.
Three. Oh this is tense now. This is properly tense.
Two. I would absolutely be answering.
One. Right then.
Five seconds. Why are you hesitating? Don’t hesitate.
Four. No no no this is where it goes wrong.
Three. This is visibly deteriorating.
Two. That’s… that’s not good.
One. I can’t watch. I have to watch. But I don’t like it.
Five seconds. Just pick something. Ideally the right thing.
Four. Think faster. That helps.
Three. If you know it, say it. If you don’t… pretend.
Two. Commit. Confidence is half of it.
One. And we’re done pretending.
Five seconds. I did explain the rules.
Four. This is not a trick question.
Three. It’s actually quite straightforward.
Two. Remarkably straightforward.
One. And yet.
Five seconds. You’ve got this. Probably.
Four. You absolutely might have this.
Three. There’s still hope. Some hope.
Two. Hope is shrinking.
One. Hope has left.
Five seconds. Still breathable.
Four. Still survivable.
Three. Tension rising.
Two. Margin gone.
One. Consequences.
